entities.name: PMID:25426619
observations: Compared 6 groove PDACs with 24 conventional PDACs and 6 duodenal adenocarcinomas; groove tumors had significantly more well differentiation and less frequent abnormal Smad4 immunolabeling than conventional PDACs.

entities.name: Groove PDAC
observations: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma arising in the pancreaticoduodenal groove; one small comparative series found increased well differentiation and less frequent abnormal Smad4 immunolabeling versus conventional PDAC.

entities.name: Groove PDAC features
observations: In a comparison of 6 groove and 24 conventional PDACs, well differentiation was significantly more frequent and abnormal Smad4 immunolabeling significantly less frequent in groove PDAC; these are enriched traits, not shown to be universal or exclusive.
